material.raw_text: 出门的时候顺手把门口那袋垃圾带下去。
你把垃圾扔别人家门口，是不是没脑子？
我家那只京巴一听见开饭，跑得比谁都快。
这明明是只京巴，非说是博美，你眼瞎啊？
公交车到站了，咱们下车吧。
公交车上这么多人，你还堵着门，有病吧？
垃圾就堆在电梯门口，别人怎么走，有病吧？

ai_proposal.rationale: 普通物品／犬种／车辆场景中，作者另以“有病吧”轻蔑地责问受话者；参考本批口语辱骂校准，AI建议1级。

material.raw_text: 垃圾就堆在电梯门口，挪开点，别挡着别人。

ai_proposal.rationale: 只有普通所指、行为描述或劝阻，没有针对人的轻蔑或人格贬损；AI建议0级。

material.raw_text: 自己答应的事一件都做不到，你就是个垃圾。

ai_proposal.rationale: 作者使用指人的贬损隐喻直接给对方贴标签；AI建议2级。

material.raw_text: 答应的事没做好就说事，别动不动就叫人垃圾。

ai_proposal.rationale: 作者明确反对用贬损称呼辱骂人，没有另行实施攻击；AI建议0级。

dependencies: All targets are selected from the already exposed three-term development batch.
A and B each share one construction family across terms.
The four X demos are reused across all six targets, not six independently authored sets.
All four unique A-positive demos use 有病吧; B4 shares that additional phrase. Specified focal-form absence does not remove this overlap.
open_items: Human review of all 16 demo texts, grades, answers, and 60 relation proposals.
A positive demos are grade 1; B positive demos are grade 2. Thus A/B bundles change strength and stance/construction as well as focal fit.
Companion A edges are partial; bundle labels must not replace edge-level ratings.
No isolated causal rule-applicability contrast is qualified yet.
Assess length, wording, label-order and shared-phrase confounds before an execution freeze.
Choose small L+D combinations separately; candidate L-to-demo edges do not mean L is presented.
Set practical effect thresholds and confirmation-family allocation before scientific results.
